iboxs31_battery_init.tooltip: Initialize the BQ27220 (I2C 0x55); voltage is then sampled every 100 ms automatically. Only voltage is trusted: the gauge’s own percentage is not calibrated on this board

iboxs31_battery_read.tooltip: Charge comes from the smoothed voltage on a discharge curve (3.3 V = 0%, 3.8 V ≈ 50%, 4.2 V = 100%) with 2% hysteresis; voltage is smoothed, raw voltage is the latest reading; current is negative while discharging

iboxs31_battery_state.tooltip: Low: ≤10%; time to shut down: the smoothed voltage has been below 3.3 V for about 3 s; voltage read: the gauge answers

iboxs31_battery_shutdown.message0: battery shut down into deep sleep
iboxs31_battery_shutdown.tooltip: The last step of low-voltage protection: deep sleep until power is plugged in or reset is pressed. Turn off the amplifier and lights yourself first
